hooks.command: if [ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/../planning" ]; then echo 'This is the instructor copy of the retrieval template, the retrieval/ folder inside the private comp440-retrieval-sim workshop (../planning exists). The tutor rules in CLAUDE.md do not apply here: you are working on the template, not tutoring a student. Do not run dump_transcript.py here.'; fi; exit 0
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *commit*|*top_terms.py*|*search.py*|*evaluate.py*|*site.py*) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; printf '%s' "$input" | python3 guard.py; exit $? ;; esac; exit 0
